info.title: The Selling Partner API for Finance Remittance
info.description: The Selling Partner API for Finance Remittance provides programmatic access to selling partner payment remittance data, including remittance summaries and detailed line items.

get.description: Returns a list of remittance summaries for the specified Amazon store, filtered by date range. Results are paginated.

parameters.name: marketplaceId
parameters.description: The `marketplaceId` is a globally unique identifier used to specify which Amazon store a request is targeting. For more information, refer to [Store Identifiers](https://developer-docs.amazon/sp-api/docs/store-identifiers).

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: The earliest payment date for remittances to include in the response. Dates are in ISO 8601 date-time format. The default is 30 days prior to the time of the request. The minimum start date is one year ago from the current date.

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: The latest payment date for remittances to include in the response. Dates are in ISO 8601 date-time format. The default is the current date-time. The maximum date range between `startDate` and `endDate` is 90 days.

parameters.name: nextToken
parameters.description: A token to fetch the next page of results. Use the value returned in the previous response.

breakdownType.description:
The type of sub-component.

**Possible values for `totalAmountBreakdown`:**

* `InvoiceAmount`: The amount on the invoice.
* `TaxAmount`: The tax amount on the invoice.

**Possible values for `netAmountPaidBreakdown`:**

* `AmountPaid`: The amount paid for the line item in the remittance.
* `TermsDiscountTaken`: The discount applied based on vendor payment terms.

Breakdown.description: A sub-component of a monetary amount.

paymentDate.description: The date of the payment in ISO 8601 date-time format.

paymentNumber.description: The external payment reference number associated with the remittance. Vendors can use this identifier to search for payment information.

uniquePaymentId.description: The unique internal identifier for the payment record in the remittance system.

paymentMethod.description: The method used for the payment.

lineItemCount.description: The number of line items in the remittance.

relatedIdentifiers.description: A list of related business identifiers for the remittance.

countryCode.description: The country code associated with the remittance in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

RemittanceHeader.description: Summary information for a remittance payment.

invoiceIssueDate.description: The invoice issue date in ISO 8601 date-time format.

totalAmountBreakdown.description:
The breakdown of `totalAmount` into sub-components.

**Possible `breakdownType` values:**

* `InvoiceAmount`: The amount on the invoice.
* `TaxAmount`: The tax amount on the invoice.

netAmountPaidBreakdown.description:
The breakdown of `netAmountPaid` into sub-components.

**Possible `breakdownType` values:**

* `AmountPaid`: The amount paid for the line item in the remittance.
* `TermsDiscountTaken`: The discount applied based on vendor payment terms. For example, early payment terms such as `1% 30, NET 60` allow a percentage discount on the invoice value when payment is made within the specified period.
